dedupe_keys.name: global dam tracker gdat georeferenced database of 35 000 dams with catchments

description: The Global Dam Tracker (GDAT) is a georeferenced global database of about 35,000 dams with cross-validated coordinates, satellite-derived catchment areas and attribute information, described in a Scientific Data descriptor. It is delivered as two ESRI shapefiles in WGS84, a point layer of dam locations and a polygon layer of dam catchments, both carrying the attributes, with a codebook that defines each variable. The authors report that it holds more records than GRanD, AQUASTAT and GeoDAR and more attribute information on completion year, location and generation capacity. Coverage is global, with dams completed up to 2018. The database is a free download from Zenodo under CC BY 4.0; replication code is a separate Zenodo deposit. Caveats: GOODD and GeoDAR lack public attributes, which limited independent checks of accuracy and duplicates. Simulation uses: exposure of dams and downstream areas, and reservoir storage in capacity planning. Related records: Global Dam Watch (data-global-dam-watch-database), GRanD (data-grand-global-reservoir-and-dam-database) and GeoDAR (data-geodar-georeferenced-global-dams-reservoirs).
